{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CJUxyvXF1LaT9zNU9HTzaQ","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Process I/O boundary for the `commonmark` executable.\n\nResponsibility: read raw bytes from `sys.stdin.buffer`, decode UTF-8 with U+FFFD replacement,\nnormalize line endings, replace U+0000, and write HTML to `sys.stdout.buffer`. Diagnostics go to\n`sys.stderr` only, and the exit status is 0 for every input.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport sys\n\nfrom mdparser import blocks, inlines, render\n\nREPLACEMENT_CHARACTER = \"�\"\nLINE_ENDING_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n|\\r|\\n\")\n\n\ndef decode_source(data: bytes) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Decode raw input bytes as UTF-8, replacing each invalid byte with U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    return data.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n\n\ndef split_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Split text on LF, CR, or CRLF, and replace each U+0000 with U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    text = text.replace(\"\\x00\", REPLACEMENT_CHARACTER)\n    return LINE_ENDING_PATTERN.split(text)\n\n\ndef render_lines(lines: list[str]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Parse the lines into a block tree and return the HTML document.\"\"\"\n    root = blocks.parse_lines(lines)\n    return render.render_document(root, inlines.parse_inline)\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    \"\"\"Run the executable: stdin Markdown to stdout HTML. Always returns 0.\"\"\"\n    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()\n    try:\n        lines = split_lines(decode_source(data))\n        html = render_lines(lines)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"commonmark: internal error: {exc!r}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        html = \"\"\n    sys.stdout.buffer.write(html.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    sys.stdout.buffer.flush()\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n\"\"\"HTML rendering.\n\nResponsibility: turn the parsed tree into HTML, escape HTML text and attributes, and\npercent-encode URLs. The conformance runner compares normalized HTML, so tag structure and\nentities must match the spec examples.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport string\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import Block\n\nInlineParser = Callable[[str], str]\n\nESCAPES = ((\"&\", \"&amp;\"), (\"<\", \"&lt;\"), (\">\", \"&gt;\"), ('\"', \"&quot;\"))\nURL_SAFE_CHARS = frozenset(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + \";,/?:@&=+$-_.!~*'()#\")\nHEX_DIGITS = frozenset(string.hexdigits)\n\n\ndef escape_html(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Escape &, <, > and \" so the text renders as literal characters. The ampersand goes first.\"\"\"\n    for raw, entity in ESCAPES:\n        text = text.replace(raw, entity)\n    return text\n\n\ndef percent_encode_url(url: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Percent-encode a URL for use in an attribute.\n\n    URL-safe ASCII and existing %XX escapes are kept. Every other character is encoded as its\n    UTF-8 bytes, so a lone % becomes %25.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(url):\n        char = url[index]\n        if char == \"%\" and _is_hex_pair(url[index + 1 : index + 3]):\n            out.append(url[index : index + 3])\n            index += 3\n            continue\n        if char in URL_SAFE_CHARS:\n            out.append(char)\n        else:\n            out.extend(f\"%{byte:02X}\" for byte in char.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _is_hex_pair(text: str) -> bool:\n    return len(text) == 2 and all(char in HEX_DIGITS for char in text)\n\n\ndef render_document(root: Block, parse_inline: InlineParser) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Phase 2 walk: render the top-level blocks in order, one line ending after each block.\n\n    `parse_inline` is the inline parser hook. It receives the raw content of each paragraph and\n    returns that content's HTML.\n    \"\"\"\n    return \"\".join(_render_block(child, parse_inline) for child in root.children)\n\n\ndef _render_block(block: Block, parse_inline: InlineParser) -> str:\n    if block.kind.name == \"paragraph\":\n        return f\"<p>{parse_inline(block.content)}</p>\\n\"\n    raise ValueError(f\"no HTML renderer for block type {block.kind.name!r}\")\n\"\"\"mdparser: a CommonMark 0.31.2 parser delivered as the stdin-to-stdout `commonmark` executable.\n\nThe package uses only the Python standard library. Its phase-1 block structure and phase-2\ninline structure live in the modules below.\n\"\"\"\n\"\"\"Raw inline HTML tests: open, closing, empty-element and attribute forms, comments, processing\ninstructions, declarations and CDATA sections, the rejected forms, and backslash inertness.\n\nEach test compares a returned string or the executable's stdout bytes with its exact expected\nvalue. No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Raw-HTML.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_open_and_close_tags_pass_through(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-open-and-close-tags: open, self-closing and closing tags pass through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    tags = '<a><bab><c2c> <a href=\"x\" data-k=v /> </a></foo >'\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"Foo \" + tags + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>Foo {tags}</p>\\n\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"fragment\",\n    [\"<!-- a comment -->\", \"<?php echo $a; ?>\", \"<!ELEMENT br EMPTY>\", \"<![CDATA[>&<]]>\"],\n)\ndef test_rawhtml_comment_pi_declaration_cdata_pass_through(\n    project_root: Path, fragment: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-comment-pi-declaration-cdata: each construct passes through verbatim.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"foo \" + fragment + \" bar\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == f\"<p>foo {fragment} bar</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_illegal_forms_are_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-illegal-forms-escaped: an illegal tag name is escaped text, not raw HTML.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"<33> <__>\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>&lt;33&gt; &lt;__&gt;</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_rawhtml_closing_tag_with_attributes_is_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC rawhtml-closing-tag-with-attributes: a closing tag with attributes is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, '</a href=\"foo\">\\n')\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\"\"\"Shared pytest fixtures for the mdparser test suite.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nPROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef project_root() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Absolute path to the application root, where `commonmark` and `pyproject.toml` live.\"\"\"\n    return PROJECT_ROOT\n#!/bin/bash\n# CommandCenter Operation\n# Name: Run Test Suite\n# Type: batch\n\n# --- Standard Preamble ---\nset -euo pipefail\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" && pwd)\"\nPROJECT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"\nLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/data/logs\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\n\nTIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S')\nSCRIPT_NAME=$(basename \"$0\" .sh)\nLOG_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/${SCRIPT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.log\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ===\" | tee \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Arguments: $*\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Working dir: $PROJECT_DIR\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"---\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n\ncd \"$PROJECT_DIR\"\n\n# --- Test Command (pyproject.toml foundation contract: pytest -q, run inside .venv) ---\nif [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; Code spans open and close on runs of equal length.\nBACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"`+\")\n\n# Whitespace in a raw HTML tag: spaces and tabs, with at most one line ending.","originalFile":"\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport string\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url\n\nASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)\n\n# The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,\n# `<` and `>`. The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n# Whitespace in a raw HTML tag: spaces and tabs, with at most one line ending.\n_WS = r\"[ \\t]*(?:\\n[ \\t]*)?\"\n# Whitespace that must be present: an attribute cannot follow its tag name or value directly.\n_WS_REQUIRED = r\"(?=[ \\t\\n])\" + _WS\n_TAG_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\"\n_ATTR_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z_:][A-Za-z0-9_.:\\-]*\"\n# An unquoted value is nonempty and has no whitespace, quote, `=`, `<`, `>` or backtick.\n_UNQUOTED_VALUE = r\"[^ \\t\\n\\r\\\"'=<>`]+\"\n_ATTR_VALUE = rf\"(?:{_UNQUOTED_VALUE}|'[^']*'|\\\"[^\\\"]*\\\")\"\n_ATTRIBUTE = rf\"{_WS_REQUIRED}{_ATTR_NAME}(?:{_WS}={_WS}{_ATTR_VALUE})?\"\n# The raw HTML grammars from the spec, tried in order. Each one is anchored at the `<` by `match`.\nRAW_HTML_PATTERNS = tuple(\n    re.compile(pattern)\n    for pattern in (\n        rf\"<{_TAG_NAME}(?:{_ATTRIBUTE})*{_WS}/?>\",\n        rf\"</{_TAG_NAME}{_WS}>\",\n        # `<!-->` and `<!--->` are complete comments; any other comment ends at the first `-->`.\n        r\"<!--(?:>|->|(?s:.*?)-->)\",\n        r\"<\\?(?s:.*?)\\?>\",\n        r\"<![A-Za-z][^>]*>\",\n        r\"<!\\[CDATA\\[(?s:.*?)\\]\\]>\",\n    )\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. An autolink or raw HTML tag starting at a `<` is taken whole, so a\n    backslash inside it stays literal and is passed through byte for byte. A backslash before ASCII\n    punctuation yields that character, so `\\\\<` does not open an autolink or raw HTML. Everything\n    else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            raw_html_end = _match_raw_html(raw, index)\n            if raw_html_end is not None:\n                out.append(raw[index:raw_html_end])\n                index = raw_html_end\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _match_raw_html(raw: str, start: int) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the index just past the raw HTML construct at `start`, or None if none matches.\"\"\"\n    for pattern in RAW_HTML_PATTERNS:\n        match = pattern.match(raw, start)\n        if match is not None:\n            return match.end()\n    return None\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; the label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":24,"oldLines":6,"newStart":24,"newLines":9,"lines":["     r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\""," )"," ","+# A backtick string is a maximal run of backticks. Code spans open and close on runs of equal length.","+BACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"`+\")","+"," # Whitespace in a raw HTML tag: spaces and tabs, with at most one line ending."," _WS = r\"[ \\t]*(?:\\n[ \\t]*)?\""," # Whitespace that must be present: an attribute cannot follow its tag name or value directly."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_017onQZo7RiBkH1cgnLakcnY","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Everything\n    else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            raw_html_end = _match_raw_html(raw, index)\n            if raw_html_end is not None:\n                out.append(raw[index:raw_html_end])\n                index = raw_html_end\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:","new_string":"    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01S1dFQtTgaFUs9KoSSdtYNV","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/inlines.py has been updated successfully."}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a212fae3-d4b7-41c5-8c45-608d073f2fa3","uuid":"87523220-b192-4af5-bff2-c47bafb65a54","timestamp":"2026-10-14T06:09:51.063Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/inlines.py","oldString":"    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. An autolink or raw HTML tag starting at a `<` is taken whole, so a\n    backslash inside it stays literal and is passed through byte for byte. A backslash before ASCII\n    punctuation yields that character, so `\\\\<` does not open an autolink or raw HTML. Everything\n    else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            raw_html_end = _match_raw_html(raw, index)\n            if raw_html_end is not None:\n                out.append(raw[index:raw_html_end])\n                index = raw_html_end\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:","newString":"    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. At each special character the constructs that start there are\n    tried, and the first one that matches is taken whole. Code spans, autolinks and raw HTML have\n    equal precedence, so whichever starts first wins. A backtick string with no closing run of the\n    same length is literal text, and the whole run is consumed. An autolink or raw HTML tag is taken\n    whole, so a backslash inside it stays literal. A backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that\n    character, so `\\\\<` and `\\\\`` do not open a construct. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"`\":\n            code_span = _match_code_span(raw, index)\n            if code_span is not None:\n                html, index = code_span\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            run_end = BACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN.match(raw, index).end()\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index:run_end]))\n            index = run_end\n            continue\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            raw_html_end = _match_raw_html(raw, index)\n            if raw_html_end is not None:\n                out.append(raw[index:raw_html_end])\n                index = raw_html_end\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:","originalFile":"\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport string\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url\n\nASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)\n\n# The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,\n# `<` and `>`. The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n# A backtick string is a maximal run of backticks. Code spans open and close on runs of equal length.\nBACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"`+\")\n\n# Whitespace in a raw HTML tag: spaces and tabs, with at most one line ending.\n_WS = r\"[ \\t]*(?:\\n[ \\t]*)?\"\n# Whitespace that must be present: an attribute cannot follow its tag name or value directly.\n_WS_REQUIRED = r\"(?=[ \\t\\n])\" + _WS\n_TAG_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\"\n_ATTR_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z_:][A-Za-z0-9_.:\\-]*\"\n# An unquoted value is nonempty and has no whitespace, quote, `=`, `<`, `>` or backtick.\n_UNQUOTED_VALUE = r\"[^ \\t\\n\\r\\\"'=<>`]+\"\n_ATTR_VALUE = rf\"(?:{_UNQUOTED_VALUE}|'[^']*'|\\\"[^\\\"]*\\\")\"\n_ATTRIBUTE = rf\"{_WS_REQUIRED}{_ATTR_NAME}(?:{_WS}={_WS}{_ATTR_VALUE})?\"\n# The raw HTML grammars from the spec, tried in order. Each one is anchored at the `<` by `match`.\nRAW_HTML_PATTERNS = tuple(\n    re.compile(pattern)\n    for pattern in (\n        rf\"<{_TAG_NAME}(?:{_ATTRIBUTE})*{_WS}/?>\",\n        rf\"</{_TAG_NAME}{_WS}>\",\n        # `<!-->` and `<!--->` are complete comments; any other comment ends at the first `-->`.\n        r\"<!--(?:>|->|(?s:.*?)-->)\",\n        r\"<\\?(?s:.*?)\\?>\",\n        r\"<![A-Za-z][^>]*>\",\n        r\"<!\\[CDATA\\[(?s:.*?)\\]\\]>\",\n    )\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. An autolink or raw HTML tag starting at a `<` is taken whole, so a\n    backslash inside it stays literal and is passed through byte for byte. A backslash before ASCII\n    punctuation yields that character, so `\\\\<` does not open an autolink or raw HTML. Everything\n    else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            raw_html_end = _match_raw_html(raw, index)\n            if raw_html_end is not None:\n                out.append(raw[index:raw_html_end])\n                index = raw_html_end\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _match_raw_html(raw: str, start: int) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the index just past the raw HTML construct at `start`, or None if none matches.\"\"\"\n    for pattern in RAW_HTML_PATTERNS:\n        match = pattern.match(raw, start)\n        if match is not None:\n            return match.end()\n    return None\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; the label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":55,"oldLines":15,"newStart":55,"newLines":27,"lines":[" def parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:","     \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content."," ","-    The scan runs left to right. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1dbMFeBDSwU8mDdZH1w","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018wfU2thVCXB1ttKYkphFo9","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/inlines.py","old_string":"def _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:","new_string":"def _match_code_span(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the code span HTML for a backtick string at `start` and the index just past it.\n\n    The span closes at the next backtick string of exactly the same length. The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n# A backtick string is a maximal run of backticks. Code spans open and close on runs of equal length.\nBACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"`+\")\n\n# Whitespace in a raw HTML tag: spaces and tabs, with at most one line ending.\n_WS = r\"[ \\t]*(?:\\n[ \\t]*)?\"\n# Whitespace that must be present: an attribute cannot follow its tag name or value directly.\n_WS_REQUIRED = r\"(?=[ \\t\\n])\" + _WS\n_TAG_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\"\n_ATTR_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z_:][A-Za-z0-9_.:\\-]*\"\n# An unquoted value is nonempty and has no whitespace, quote, `=`, `<`, `>` or backtick.\n_UNQUOTED_VALUE = r\"[^ \\t\\n\\r\\\"'=<>`]+\"\n_ATTR_VALUE = rf\"(?:{_UNQUOTED_VALUE}|'[^']*'|\\\"[^\\\"]*\\\")\"\n_ATTRIBUTE = rf\"{_WS_REQUIRED}{_ATTR_NAME}(?:{_WS}={_WS}{_ATTR_VALUE})?\"\n# The raw HTML grammars from the spec, tried in order. Each one is anchored at the `<` by `match`.\nRAW_HTML_PATTERNS = tuple(\n    re.compile(pattern)\n    for pattern in (\n        rf\"<{_TAG_NAME}(?:{_ATTRIBUTE})*{_WS}/?>\",\n        rf\"</{_TAG_NAME}{_WS}>\",\n        # `<!-->` and `<!--->` are complete comments; any other comment ends at the first `-->`.\n        r\"<!--(?:>|->|(?s:.*?)-->)\",\n        r\"<\\?(?s:.*?)\\?>\",\n        r\"<![A-Za-z][^>]*>\",\n        r\"<!\\[CDATA\\[(?s:.*?)\\]\\]>\",\n    )\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. A backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that\n    character, so `\\\\<` and `\\\\`` do not open a construct. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"`\":\n            code_span = BACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN.match(raw, index).end()\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index:run_end]))\n            index = run_end\n            continue\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Code spans$|^Inlines$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\ndef Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-backtick-length-match: a double-backtick span keeps a single backtick inside.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"``a`b``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>a`b</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-unclosed-literal: an unmatched backtick run is literal text, no code element.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"```foo``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Code-Spans.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_corpus_sections_pass_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-corpus-sections: the scoped Code spans and Inlines sections exit 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Code spans$|^Inlines$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\ndef test_codespans_simple(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-simple: a single-backtick span renders one code element with its content.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`some code`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>some code</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_length_match(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-backtick-length-match: a double-backtick span keeps a single backtick inside.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"``a`b``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>a`b</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-unclosed-literal: an unmatched backtick run is literal text, no code element.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"```foo``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>```foo``</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escapes_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-escapes-inert: a backslash inside a code span is kept literally.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`\\\\[`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>\\\\[</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Opening and closing runs ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_empty_span_is_empty_code(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A two-backtick run with nothing between closes immediately and renders empty code.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"``\") == \"``\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"````\") == \"<code></code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_longer_run_does_not_close_shorter(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A run of three does not close a span opened by a run of one.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a```\") == \"<code>a```</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_consumes_whole_run(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unclosed run is literal as a whole and is not reread as a shorter opener.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"``foo`\") == \"``foo`\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_then_later_span(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A literal run does not block a later code span of its own length.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`` x ` `y`\") == \"`` x <code>y</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_adjacent_spans(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Two spans in a row each render as their own code element.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a``b`\") == \"<code>a</code><code>b</code>\"\n\n\n# --- Content normalization ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"raw\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\" a \", \"<code>a</code>\"),\n        (\"  a  \", \"<code> a </code>\"),\n        (\"a \", \"<code>a </code>\"),\n        (\" a\", \"<code> a</code>\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_codespans_strip_only_one_space_from_each_end(\n    raw: str, expected: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"One space is removed from each end only when both ends are spaces.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(f\"`{raw}`\") == expected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"raw\", [\" \", \"   \"])\ndef test_codespans_all_spaces_are_not_stripped(raw: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Content made entirely of spaces keeps every space.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(f\"`{raw}`\") == f\"<code>{raw}</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_only_ascii_space_is_stripped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A tab at either end is not stripped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`\\ta\\t`\") == \"<code>\\ta\\t</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_line_ending_becomes_space(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A line ending inside a span becomes a space, and interior spaces are not collapsed.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a\\nb  c`\") == \"<code>a b  c</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_content_is_html_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Angle brackets, ampersands and quotes in the content are escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('`<a href=\"&\">`') == \"<code>&lt;a href=&quot;&amp;&quot;&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_entities_are_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An entity inside a span is shown as written, with its ampersand escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`&amp;`\") == \"<code>&amp;amp;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backslash_before_closing_run_is_content(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash just before the closing run stays in the content and does not escape it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`foo\\\\`bar`\") == \"<code>foo\\\\</code>bar\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escaped_opener_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a backtick makes that backtick literal and opens no span.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\`foo`\") == \"`foo`\"\n\n\n# --- Precedence against autolinks and raw HTML ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_first_beats_raw_html(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"When a span starts before a tag, the span takes the tag's characters as content.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`<a>`\") == \"<code>&lt;a&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_raw_html_first_beats_backtick(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"When a tag starts before a backtick, the tag is taken whole and the backtick is literal.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<a `>`\") == \"<a `>`\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_first_beats_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A span that starts before an autolink keeps the autolink's text as code content.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`<http://a.b>`\") == \"<code>&lt;http://a.b&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_autolink_first_beats_backtick(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An autolink that starts before a backtick is taken whole, and the backtick is literal.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://a.b`>`\") == '<a href=\"http://a.b`\">http://a.b`</a>`'\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_inside_raw_html_attribute_is_not_an_opener(\n    project_root: Path,\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backtick inside a raw HTML tag is part of the tag, so no span opens there.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a href=\"`\">x`') == '<a href=\"`\">x`'\n\n\n# --- Executable boundary ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_whole_document_stdout(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A paragraph with a span renders as one paragraph element on stdout.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"Use `x` here\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>Use <code>x</code> here</p>\\n\"\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01JTGuFBf517DsPF1Fw5SfEJ","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Code-Spans.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_corpus_sections_pass_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-corpus-sections: the scoped Code spans and Inlines sections exit 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Code spans$|^Inlines$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\ndef test_codespans_simple(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-simple: a single-backtick span renders one code element with its content.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`some code`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>some code</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_length_match(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-backtick-length-match: a double-backtick span keeps a single backtick inside.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"``a`b``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>a`b</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-unclosed-literal: an unmatched backtick run is literal text, no code element.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"```foo``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>```foo``</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escapes_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-escapes-inert: a backslash inside a code span is kept literally.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`\\\\[`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>\\\\[</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Opening and closing runs ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_empty_span_is_empty_code(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A two-backtick run with nothing between closes immediately and renders empty code.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"``\") == \"``\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"````\") == \"<code></code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_longer_run_does_not_close_shorter(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A run of three does not close a span opened by a run of one.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a```\") == \"<code>a```</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_consumes_whole_run(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unclosed run is literal as a whole and is not reread as a shorter opener.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"``foo`\") == \"``foo`\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_then_later_span(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A literal run does not block a later code span of its own length.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`` x ` `y`\") == \"`` x <code>y</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_adjacent_spans(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Two spans in a row each render as their own code element.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a``b`\") == \"<code>a</code><code>b</code>\"\n\n\n# --- Content normalization ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"raw\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\" a \", \"<code>a</code>\"),\n        (\"  a  \", \"<code> a </code>\"),\n        (\"a \", \"<code>a </code>\"),\n        (\" a\", \"<code> a</code>\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_codespans_strip_only_one_space_from_each_end(\n    raw: str, expected: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"One space is removed from each end only when both ends are spaces.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(f\"`{raw}`\") == expected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"raw\", [\" \", \"   \"])\ndef test_codespans_all_spaces_are_not_stripped(raw: test_codespans_only_ascii_space_is_stripped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A tab at either end is not stripped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`\\ta\\t`\") == \"<code>\\ta\\t</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_line_ending_becomes_space(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A line ending inside a span becomes a space, and interior spaces are not collapsed.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a\\nb  c`\") == \"<code>a b  c</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_content_is_html_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Angle brackets, ampersands and quotes in the content are escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('`<a href=\"&\">`') == \"<code>&lt;a href=&quot;&amp;&quot;&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_entities_are_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An entity inside a span is shown as written, with its ampersand escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`&amp;`\") == \"<code>&amp;amp;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backslash_before_closing_run_is_content(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash just before the closing run stays in the content and does not escape it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`foo\\\\`bar`\") == \"<code>foo\\\\</code>bar\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escaped_opener_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A \"\"\"A span that starts before an autolink keeps the autolink's text as code content.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`<http://a.b>`\") == \"<code>&lt;http://a.b&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_autolink_first_beats_backtick(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An autolink that starts before a backtick is taken whole, and the backtick is literal.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://a.b`>`\") == '<a href=\"http://a.b`\">http://a.b`</a>`'\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_inside_raw_html_attribute_is_not_an_opener(\n    project_root: Path,\n) -> No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Code-Spans.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_corpus_sections_pass_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-corpus-sections: the scoped Code spans and Inlines sections exit 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Code spans$|^Inlines$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\ndef test_codespans_simple(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-simple: a single-backtick span renders one code element with its content.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`some code`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>some code</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_length_match(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-backtick-length-match: a double-backtick span keeps a single backtick inside.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"``a`b``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>a`b</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-unclosed-literal: an unmatched backtick run is literal text, no code element.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"```foo``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>```foo``</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escapes_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-escapes-inert: a backslash inside a code span is kept literally.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`\\\\[`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>\\\\[</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Opening and closing runs ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_run_with_no_content_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Adjacent runs form one maximal run with no content, so no span can open or close on it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"````\") == \"````\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_longer_run_does_not_close_shorter(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A run of three does not close a span opened by a run of one, so the span stays unmatched.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a```\") == \"`a```\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_consumes_whole_run(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unclosed run is literal as a whole and is not reread as a shorter opener.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"``foo`\") == \"``foo`\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_then_later_span(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A literal run does not block a later code span of its own length.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`` x ` `y`\") == \"`` x <code>y</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_adjacent_spans(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Two spans in a row each render as their own code element.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a``b`\") == \"<code>a</code><code>b</code>\"\n\n\n# --- Content normalization ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"raw\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\" a \", \"<code>a</code>\"),\n        (\"  a  \", \"<code> a </code>\"),\n        (\"a \", \"<code>a </code>\"),\n        (\" a\", \"<code> a</code>\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_codespans_strip_only_one_space_from_each_end(\n    raw: str, expected: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"One space is removed from each end only when both ends are spaces.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(f\"`{raw}`\") == expected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"raw\", [\" \", \"   \"])\ndef test_codespans_all_spaces_are_not_stripped(raw: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Content made entirely of spaces keeps every space.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(f\"`{raw}`\") == f\"<code>{raw}</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_only_ascii_space_is_stripped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A tab at either end is not stripped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`\\ta\\t`\") == \"<code>\\ta\\t</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_line_ending_becomes_space(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A line ending inside a span becomes a space, and interior spaces are not collapsed.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a\\nb  c`\") == \"<code>a b  c</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_content_is_html_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Angle brackets, ampersands and quotes in the content are escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('`<a href=\"&\">`') == \"<code>&lt;a href=&quot;&amp;&quot;&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_entities_are_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An entity inside a span is shown as written, with its ampersand escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`&amp;`\") == \"<code>&amp;amp;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backslash_before_closing_run_is_content(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash just before the closing run stays in the content and does not escape it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`foo\\\\`bar`\") == \"<code>foo\\\\</code>bar\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escaped_opener_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a backtick makes that backtick literal and opens no span.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\`foo`\") == \"`foo`\"\n\n\n# --- Precedence against autolinks and raw HTML ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_first_beats_raw_html(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"When a span starts before a tag, the span takes the tag's characters as content.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`<a>`\") == \"<code>&lt;a&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_raw_html_first_beats_backtick(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"When a tag starts before a backtick, the tag is taken whole and the backtick is literal.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<a `>`\") == \"<a `>`\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_first_beats_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A span that starts before an autolink keeps the autolink's No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Code-Spans.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_corpus_sections_pass_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-corpus-sections: the scoped Code spans and Inlines sections exit 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Code spans$|^Inlines$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\ndef test_codespans_simple(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-simple: a single-backtick span renders one code element with its content.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`some code`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>some code</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_length_match(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-backtick-length-match: a double-backtick span keeps a single backtick inside.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"``a`b``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>a`b</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-unclosed-literal: an unmatched backtick run is literal text, no code element.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"```foo``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>```foo``</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escapes_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-escapes-inert: a backslash inside a code span is kept literally.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`\\\\[`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>\\\\[</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Opening and closing runs ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_run_with_no_content_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Adjacent runs form one maximal run with no content, so no span can open or close on it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"````\") == \"````\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_longer_run_does_not_close_shorter(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A run of three does not close a span opened by a run of one, so the span stays unmatched.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a```\") == \"`a```\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_consumes_whole_run(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unclosed run is literal as a whole and is not reread as a shorter opener.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"``foo`\") == \"``foo`\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_then_later_span(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A literal run does not block a later code span of its own length.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`` x `y`\") == \"`` x <code>y</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_adjacent_spans(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Two spans separated by a space each render as their own code element.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a` `b`\") == \"<code>a</code> <code>b</code>\"\n\n\n# --- Content normalization ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"raw\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\" a \", \"<code>a</code>\"),\n        (\"  a  \", \"<code> a </code>\"),\n        (\"a \", \"<code>a </code>\"),\n        (\" a\", \"<code> a</code>\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_codespans_strip_only_one_space_from_each_end(\n    raw: str, expected: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"One space is removed from each end only when both ends are spaces.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(f\"`{raw}`\") == expected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"raw\", [\" \", \"   \"])\ndef test_codespans_all_spaces_are_not_stripped(raw: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Content made entirely of spaces keeps every space.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(f\"`{raw}`\") == f\"<code>{raw}</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_only_ascii_space_is_stripped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A tab at either end is not stripped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`\\ta\\t`\") == \"<code>\\ta\\t</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_line_ending_becomes_space(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A line ending inside a span becomes a space, and interior spaces are not collapsed.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a\\nb  c`\") == \"<code>a b  c</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_content_is_html_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Angle brackets, ampersands and quotes in the content are escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('`<a href=\"&\">`') == \"<code>&lt;a href=&quot;&amp;&quot;&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_entities_are_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An entity inside a span is shown as written, with its ampersand escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`&amp;`\") == \"<code>&amp;amp;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backslash_before_closing_run_is_content(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash just before the closing run stays in the content and does not escape it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`foo\\\\`bar`\") == \"<code>foo\\\\</code>bar\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escaped_opener_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a backtick makes that backtick literal and opens no span.\"\"\"\n    assert \"\"\"When a span starts before a tag, the span takes the tag's characters as content.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`<a>`\") == \"<code>&lt;a&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Code-Spans.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_corpus_sections_pass_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-corpus-sections: the scoped Code spans and Inlines sections exit 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Code spans$|^Inlines$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\ndef test_codespans_simple(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-simple: a single-backtick span renders one code element with its content.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`some code`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>some code</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_length_match(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-backtick-length-match: a double-backtick span keeps a single backtick inside.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"``a`b``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>a`b</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-unclosed-literal: an unmatched backtick run is literal text, no code element.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"```foo``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>```foo``</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escapes_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-escapes-inert: a backslash inside a code span is kept literally.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`\\\\[`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>\\\\[</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Opening and closing runs ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_run_with_no_content_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Adjacent runs form one maximal run with no content, so no span can open or close on it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"````\") == \"````\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_longer_run_does_not_close_shorter(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A run of three does not close a span opened by a run of one, so the span stays unmatched.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a```\") == \"`a```\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_consumes_whole_run(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unclosed run is literal as a whole and is not reread as a shorter opener.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"``foo`\") == \"``foo`\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_then_later_span(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A literal run does not block a later code span of its own length.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`` x `y`\") == \"`` x <code>y</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_adjacent_spans(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Two spans separated by a space each render as their own code element.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a` `b`\") == \"<code>a</code> <code>b</code>\"\n\n\n# --- Content normalization ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"raw\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\" a \", \"<code>a</code>\"),\n        (\"  a  \", \"<code> a </code>\"),\n        (\"a \", \"<code>a </code>\"),\n        (\" a\", \"<code> a</code>\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_codespans_strip_only_one_space_from_each_end(\n    raw: str, expected: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"One space is removed from each end only when both ends are spaces.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(f\"`{raw}`\") == expected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"raw\", [\" \", \"   \"])\ndef test_codespans_all_spaces_are_not_stripped(raw: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Content made entirely of spaces keeps every space.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(f\"`{raw}`\") == f\"<code>{raw}</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_only_ascii_space_is_stripped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A tab at either end is not stripped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`\\ta\\t`\") == \"<code>\\ta\\t</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_line_ending_becomes_space(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A line ending inside a span becomes a space, and interior spaces are not collapsed.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a\\nb  c`\") == \"<code>a b  c</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_content_is_html_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Angle brackets, ampersands and quotes in the content are escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('`<a href=\"&\">`') == \"<code>&lt;a href=&quot;&amp;&quot;&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_entities_are_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An entity inside a span is shown as written, with its ampersand escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`&amp;`\") == \"<code>&amp;amp;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backslash_before_closing_run_is_content(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash just before the closing run stays in the content and does not escape it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`foo\\\\`bar`\") == \"<code>foo\\\\</code>bar\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escaped_opener_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a backtick makes that backtick literal and opens no span.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\`foo`\") == \"`foo`\"\n\n\n# --- Precedence against autolinks and raw HTML ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_first_beats_raw_html(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"When a span starts before a tag, the span takes the tag's characters as content.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`<a>`\") == \"<code>&lt;a&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_raw_html_first_beats_backtick(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A tag that starts before a backtick is taken whole, even when it holds a backtick.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a t=\"`\">`') == '<a t=\"`\">`'\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_first_beats_autolink(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A span that starts before an autolink keeps the autolink's text as code content.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`<http://a.b>`\") == \"<code>&lt;http://a.b&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_autolink_first_beats_backtick(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An autolink that starts before a backtick is taken whole, and the backtick is literal.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"<http://a.b`>`\") == '<a href=\"http://a.b`\">http://a.b`</a>`'\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_inside_raw_html_attribute_is_not_an_opener(\n    project_root: Path,\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backtick inside a raw HTML tag is part of the tag, so no span opens there.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('<a href=\"`\">x`') == '<a href=\"`\">x`'\n\n\n# --- Executable boundary ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_whole_document_stdout(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A paragraph with a span renders as one paragraph element on stdout.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"Use No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Code-Spans.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_corpus_sections_pass_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-corpus-sections: the scoped Code spans and Inlines sections exit 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Code spans$|^Inlines$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\ndef test_codespans_simple(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-simple: a single-backtick span renders one code element with its content.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`some code`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>some code</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_length_match(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-backtick-length-match: a double-backtick span keeps a single backtick inside.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"``a`b``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>a`b</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-unclosed-literal: an unmatched backtick run is literal text, no code element.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"```foo``\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>```foo``</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_escapes_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-escapes-inert: a backslash inside a code span is kept literally.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`\\\\[`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>\\\\[</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Opening and closing runs ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_run_with_no_content_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Adjacent runs form one maximal run with no content, so no span can open or close on it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"````\") == \"````\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_longer_run_does_not_close_shorter(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A run of three does not close a span opened by a run of one, so the span stays unmatched.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a```\") == \"`a```\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_consumes_whole_run(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unclosed run is literal as a whole and is not reread as a shorter opener.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"``foo`\") == \"``foo`\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_unclosed_run_then_later_span(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A literal run does not block a later code span of its own length.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`` x `y`\") == \"`` x <code>y</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_adjacent_spans(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Two spans separated by a space each render as their own code element.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a` `b`\") == \"<code>a</code> <code>b</code>\"\n\n\n# --- Content normalization ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"raw\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\" a \", \"<code>a</code>\"),\n        (\"  a  \", \"<code> a </code>\"),\n        (\"a \", \"<code>a </code>\"),\n        (\" a\", \"<code> a</code>\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_codespans_strip_only_one_space_from_each_end(\n    raw: str, expected: str\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"One space is removed from each end only when both ends are spaces.\"\"\"\n    assert Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A line ending inside a span becomes a space, and interior spaces are not collapsed.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`a\\nb  c`\") == \"<code>a b  c</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_content_is_html_escaped(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Angle brackets, ampersands and quotes in the content are escaped.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('`<a href=\"&\">`') == \"<code>&lt;a href=&quot;&amp;&quot;&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_entities_are_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An entity inside a span is shown as written, with test_codespans_escaped_opener_is_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a backtick makes that backtick literal and opens no span.\"\"\"\n    assert \"\"\"When a span starts before a tag, the span takes the tag's characters as content.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"`<a>`\") == \"<code>&lt;a&gt;</code>\"\n\n\ndef
